description: New UI threads on Aegra: stream an Orchestra graph and tool through the current chat view without changing legacy threads.

userStories.title: Run an Orchestra graph with a tool on Aegra
userStories.description: As a chat user, I want my new thread to use an Orchestra tool through Aegra so that I can complete a task.
acceptanceCriteria: First add a failing integration test for a new Aegra thread with two turns and one deterministic Orchestra tool call.
Register the real Orchestra chat graph with Aegra. The test observes the tool call, tool result, streamed reply, and persisted second-turn context.
Authenticate each run with Orchestra's current credential authority. Reject missing credentials, unknown tools, and cross-user thread or stream access.
Keep new Aegra thread and run data outside Orchestra's existing tables. The test finds no new Orchestra thread row for the Aegra run.
No new-thread request invokes Orchestra `stream_generator` or `LLMController.llm_stream`.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: test module-load failed before implementation, exit 1. 2 executed: bash backend/scripts/test-aegra-chat-stream.sh exit 0, 3 passed; real graph/tool/result/second-turn state asserted. 3 executed: same test covers missing, invalid, revoked, unknown-tool, spoofed identity, and second-user thread/run/stream denials. 4 executed: test asserts native thread/run/checkpoint rows and no Orchestra thread row or store entry; disposable DB dropped and absent. 5 executed: test failure sentinels assert legacy stream_generator and LLMController.llm_stream uncalled. Advisor independently reran the runner: exit 0, 3 passed, disposable DB dropped and absent. README trim commit 061fe8a6 passed STE checker and git diff --check.

userStories.title: Create an Aegra thread through the current UI
userStories.description: As a chat user, I want New Thread to stream Aegra replies and tool results so that I can use the current chat view.
acceptanceCriteria: First add failing UI tests for first-message thread creation, tool events, reply completion, errors, and a second message.
After New Thread and the first message, the UI creates an Aegra thread and displays its tool call, result, and streamed reply.
A second message in that thread runs through Aegra and uses the first turn's history.
Keep existing Orchestra-owned threads on their current routes. Do not dual-write a new thread or redirect an old thread to Aegra.
Reject unsupported new-thread inputs before execution. Do not reject supported Orchestra tools.
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill.
userStories.notes: Frontend regressions went red before repair. Advisor independently ran six focused test files: 67 passed, exit 0; frontend build exit 0. Browser review in the local authenticated UI created Aegra thread 5397299e-69bd-4a5a-9e5b-639511982204, displayed math_calculator call/result 7 * 8 = 56 and streamed reply, then returned 56 in a second run on the same thread while remaining on /chat. Existing persistent context files did not block text submission. Explicit attachments show an error and restore the prompt in focused tests. Legacy route and no-fallback cases are covered by focused tests. UI commits: 10c47930, 97d5b382, 26f78b9d, 7728dfc4. See evidence/manual-review.md.

userStories.title: Review the UI journey
userStories.description: As an operator, I want observed browser and API evidence so that I can accept the new-thread path.
acceptanceCriteria: After operator approval for disposable local resources, record redacted commands and route responses in `.agro/tasks/aegra-stream-api/evidence/manual-review.md`.
Record an agent-browser journey with annotated screenshots: New Thread, a tool call and result, a streamed reply, and a second turn.
Confirm that a second user cannot read the new thread or attach to its run stream.
Stop the review service and delete only resources created for this review. Use the evidence for the PR `## Manual review` section.
